content.short: Hakka Finance is a DAO-structured DeFi-centric protocol with products including the DeFi Handbook and BlackHoleSwap.
content.description: Formed within a DAO, Hakka Finance is a DeFi-centric protocol offering products like the DeFi Handbook and BlackHoleSwap. The project invites learning about DeFi through a play-to-earn program that lets participants explore core DeFi concepts while earning rewards. As with many protocols, Hakka supports staking and farming, and the HAKKA token is available on major DEXs such as Balancer, 1inch, and Uniswap.
